title: Publish, sync and the leak scan agree on tree causes, lanes and secret shapes, and the query-log spool and needs-you line stop naming dead deliveries
goal: Publish refuses only real tree causes and passes the range since the last publish, and an unreadable root file counts as not public; contribute holds back every non-public root, passes each file's root to the leak scan and checks the git version up front; sync treats every commit as content when lane_module is empty; the leak scan reports a url password with an angle bracket or a backslash in the scp form and passes the root to a replacing extender; reredact reports a fetch host the public-host gate refuses; an ended query-log session is delivered and removed or kept with a reason; the needs-you line names no refused delivery when the panel counts no undelivered entry

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
